This is the Official Takis Shelter Channel

Takis Shelter is a no-cage, no-kill shelter in Ierapetra, Greece. In its everyday life, Takis Shelter rescues dogs and cats from the streets. These animals are either strays, have been abused, or have been in accidents and are in urgent need of help. The channel documents the rescue efforts, the daily life in the shelter, and the rehabilitation and adoption stories of these dogs and cats.

Legal information:
Legal name of NPO: STEGI PROSTASIAS ADESPOTON ZOON (Takis Shelter)

The channel is operated and managed by Takis Shelter NPO, based in Ierapetra, Greece.

Contact: contact@takisshelter.org

We receive revenue from YouTube advertising (YouTube Partner Program).

We do not receive public funding or advertising revenue from state authorities or third countries.
